title: AI Model Analysis — implementation
summary: Generate AI critiques that explain policy models in plain language (executive summary, strengths, weaknesses, hidden trade-offs, implementation risks, socio-economic impacts, alternatives) while keeping scoring strictly deterministic. AI interprets; it never scores. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: For a saved model, the AI produces all seven critique sections
Critique is grounded in the model's actual inputs, outputs and scores
The deterministic score is unchanged by, and shown independently of, the AI
notes:
Scope (in): Critique outputs: executive summary, strengths, weaknesses, hidden trade-offs, implementation risks, socio-economic impacts, alternative recommendations
Out of scope: Any AI influence on scores (EPIC-003 stays deterministic); The provider framework (EPIC-008) and user keys (EPIC-009)
